title: Semantic HTML
definition: Semantic HTML involves using HTML markup to reinforce the semantics (meaning) of the information in web pages, rather than merely defining its presentation (e.g., using `<nav>` instead of `<div class='nav'>`).
simpleExplanation: Using the correct tags so screen readers understand that this text is a 'Button' and that text is the 'Main Heading', rather than just styling everything as a generic box (div).
